bibl.seg: Roger S. Bagnall & Alexander Jones, P.Math. Leaf A Verso, Mathematical Problem a3 Revisited: A New Algorithm in Greek Mensurational Mathematics.
Pylon. Editions and Studies of Ancient Texts 2 (2022) §1-19, figg.
bibl.note: P. Math. (= LDAB 10719). - The mathematical problem a3 (leaf A verso, lines 1-7) is about an object having the form of a flat ring something over a meter broad and a rectangular cross-section twice as broad as it was thick, perhaps the felloe or outer rim (ἴτυς) of a large wheel.
